520	/-! ## §5. The ℙ¹ reduction skeleton (Mumford AV II §5 route)
521	
522	The B3 discharge route: push `L` forward along the finite map
523	`π_A : C_A ⟶ ℙ¹_A` (base change of the gate `HasFiniteMapToP1`'s finite
524	`C ⟶ ℙ¹`, which is exportable via choice — `finiteMapToP1` below — since
525	`IsFinite` is `Prop`-valued), then run the two-term finite free replacement
526	on the explicit 2-chart Čech complex of `ℙ¹_A`
527	(`p1BaseChangeCoverSquare` + `AffineCoverMVSquare.moduleSectionRes`/
528	`moduleSectionDiff`).  This section builds the *proved* part of that route:
529	
530	* the base-changed finite map and its finiteness
531	  (`isFinite_finiteMapToP1BaseChange`, by base-change stability of
532	  `IsFinite` along the cartesian square `C_A = C ×_{ℙ¹} ℙ¹_A`);
533	* the pushforward factorization `q_* ≅ p_* ∘ (π_A)_*`
534	  (`pushforwardFactorThroughP1Iso`, pseudofunctoriality);
535	* the standard 2-chart affine cover of `ℙ¹_A`;
536	* the **reduction theorem** `rigidPushforwardLocallyFree_of_p1`:
537	  B3-local-freeness for `C_A` follows from the ℙ¹ engine
538	  (`P1RigidPushforwardStatement`) plus a named finite-pushforward transfer
539	  package (coherence, base-flatness, and fibrewise `h⁰`/`h¹` transfer along
540	  the affine map `π_A` — the honest dévissage lemmas of the B3 discharge,
541	  Stacks 01XZ/02KE-grade, taken as hypotheses here and proved in the B3
542	  session). -/

544	namespace Adelic
545	
546	open Scheme
547	
548	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
549	
550	/-- The projective line `ℙ¹_k` as an object of `Over (Spec k)` — the target
551	of the finite-map gate `HasFiniteMapToP1`. -/
552	noncomputable abbrev p1Over (k : Type u) [Field k] : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
553	  Over.mk (ℙ(ULift.{u} (Fin 2); Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
554	
555	/-- **Choice extraction of the finite map to `ℙ¹`** from the gate
556	`HasFiniteMapToP1` (audit note: the gate stores a `Prop`-valued existential,
557	so the morphism itself is exportable only via `Classical.choice`; all
558	downstream uses are propositional, so this is harmless).  Everything the
559	reduction needs about it is `isFinite_finiteMapToP1_left`. -/
560	noncomputable def finiteMapToP1 (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [HasFiniteMapToP1 C] :
561	    C ⟶ p1Over k :=
562	  (HasFiniteMapToP1.nonempty_finite_map (C := C)).choose
563	
564	instance isFinite_finiteMapToP1_left (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
565	    [HasFiniteMapToP1 C] : IsFinite (finiteMapToP1 C).left :=
566	  (HasFiniteMapToP1.nonempty_finite_map (C := C)).choose_spec
567	
568	variable (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
569	
570	/-- The chart projection `ℙ¹_A ⟶ ℙ¹_k` is affine: it is the base change of
571	the affine morphism `Spec A ⟶ Spec k`. -/
572	instance isAffineHom_p1BaseChange_fst :
573	    IsAffineHom (pullback.fst (p1Over k).hom
574	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))) :=
575	  MorphismProperty.pullback_fst (P := @IsAffineHom) (p1Over k).hom
576	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
577	    (inferInstance : IsAffineHom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
578	
579	/-- **The standard 2-chart affine cover of `ℙ¹_A`**: the preimage of the
580	standard cover `p1CoverSquare` of `ℙ¹_k` under the (affine, being a base
581	change of the affine `Spec A ⟶ Spec k`) projection `ℙ¹_A ⟶ ℙ¹_k`.  The
582	two-term complex `moduleSectionRes`/`moduleSectionDiff` on this cover is
583	the explicit 2-chart Čech complex of `ℙ¹_A` that the Mumford AV II §5
584	finite free replacement consumes. -/
585	noncomputable def p1BaseChangeCoverSquare :
586	    (Limits.pullback (p1Over k).hom
587	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).AffineCoverMVSquare :=
588	  @Scheme.AffineCoverMVSquare.preimage _ _ (p1CoverSquare k)
589	    (pullback.fst (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))
590	    (isAffineHom_p1BaseChange_fst A)
591	
592	variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
593	
594	/-- **The base-changed finite map `π_A : C_A ⟶ ℙ¹_A`**: the functorial map
595	between the pullbacks along `Spec A ⟶ Spec k` induced by the finite
596	`π : C ⟶ ℙ¹` of the gate. -/
597	noncomputable def finiteMapToP1BaseChange [HasFiniteMapToP1 C] :
598	    Limits.pullback C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) ⟶
599	      Limits.pullback (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) :=
600	  pullback.map C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
601	    (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
602	    (finiteMapToP1 C).left (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _)
603	    (by rw [Category.comp_id]; exact (Over.w (finiteMapToP1 C)).symm)
604	    (by simp)
605	
606	/-- `π_A` is a map of families over `Spec A`: it commutes with the two
607	projections (the triangle `q = π_A ≫ p`). -/
608	@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
609	lemma finiteMapToP1BaseChange_snd [HasFiniteMapToP1 C] :
610	    finiteMapToP1BaseChange A C ≫
611	        pullback.snd (p1Over k).hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) =
612	      pullback.snd C.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) :=
613	  (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _).trans (Category.comp_id _)
614
